name: Nexthop
summary: Australian telecommunications carrier providing wholesale dark fibre, IP Transit and internet; launched 2016 on the former Zed Connect ASN (AS9507); operates in Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane and Perth.

events.details: Launched 2016; ASN AS9507 re-registered to NextHop Pty Ltd Jul 2016 (previously held by Zed Connect since c.2001). Began fibre build 2018 Sydney CBD.
